text: Yes, deforestation occurred on this asset in 2023. The evidence supports tree-cover loss of about 0.7 hectares within the asset during that year. This loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated by the method used, which involved checking a later year's observation and agreeing with the JRC 2020 reference for the event area. The asset is a rural property of approximately 58.1 hectares.
